content.text: reg fluid balance and n./musc funct
Primary intracell cation; critical for ♡ and musc funct
Main extracell anion; works w sodium to maintain fluid and acid-base balance
Reflects body's buffering capacity; main component of acid-base balance
↑: met alkalosis (vomiting, diuretics, excessive antacid use)
↓: met acidosis (DKA, renal failure, lactic acidosis)
Waste product of protein met, cleared by kidneys
↑: dehydration, renal failure, ↑protein intake, GI bleed, musc breakdown
Ratio used to differentiate pre-renal vs intrinsic renal Eti
<10: intrinsic renal dz, malnutrition, liver failure
Blood sugar level; reg by insulin & glucagon
Regulated by PTH and vit D
essential for bone health, clotting, ♡ funct
↑ (hypercalcemia): hyperparathyroidism, malig, vit D toxicity (confusion, stones)
↓ (hypocalcemia): hypoparathyroidism, vit D deficiency, pancreatitis (tetany, sz)
↓levels allow fluid to leak into tissues
↓ albumin: malnutrition, liver dz, nephrotic syndrome, chronic illness
Enzymes released when liver or musc cells are damaged
Marked ↑: viral hepatitis, drug-induced liver inj, ischemic hepatitis
AST > ALT ratio suggests alcoholic hepatitis
Enzyme from liver, bone, bile ducts
↑in cholestatic liver dz and bone dx
↑: cholestasis, Paget's dz, bone metastases, PBC
Isolated ALP elevation w norm transaminases suggests bone or bile duct origin
